events.title: Arrest warrant issued for Rosa Tenorio
events.summary: The New Haven police department and the FBI obtained a felony arrest warrant for Rosa Tenorio, who abducted her daughter, Andrea Michelle Reyes, from Connecticut in 1999. Tenorio fled to Mexico with Reyes, who was two years old at the time. The case went cold until 2023 when a detective re-investigated and located Reyes in Puebla, Mexico. Advanced DNA testing confirmed her identity, and the arrest warrant for Tenorio remains active in the United States.
events.why_relevant: This event demonstrates the ongoing efforts of law enforcement to resolve cold cases and enforce legal custody rights.
